warnings.label: Christchurch Harbour
warnings.description: Christchurch Harbour
warnings.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain. 
Tidal conditions are expected to improve and no flooding is expected.   
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.   
If you have been evacuated only return to your property once the emergency services have advised that it is safe to do so. Never drive through flood water,  just 30cm of fast flowing water is enough to move your car.

warnings.label: South Devon coast from Start Point to Dawlish Warren
warnings.description: South Devon coast from Start Point to Dawlish Warren
warnings.eaArea: Devon, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly
warnings.message:
High tides this evening may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible Flooding is possible 2 hours either side of high tides on Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning. 
Areas particularly at risk include Torbay, Teignmouth, Beesands, Torcross, Slapton and Dawlish. Locations most affected will be coastal roads and footpaths. The high tide at Teignmouth on Tuesday evening is at 9:15pm, times of high water will vary along the coast. The forecast total high tide level is 2.62mAOD, which is 0.43 metres above tide table level. Strong force 5-6, south easterly winds and offshore wave heights of over 1m are forecast over the high tide. Similar coastal conditions are expected for Wednesday morning's high tide at 9:30am, with a slightly lower tide level. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water . 
This message will be updated by 3:00PM on 30 September 2026 or as the situation changes.
